1.text: One room. One way out. Start with what I can reach.
My fingers keep finding chord shapes. I don't remember learning them.
He is coughing too. A uniform does not keep the sickness out.

2.text: They call this protection. Why do the locks face inward?
No symptoms. No hearing. A name on a list is enough.

3.text: Every door trusts an order. Maybe I can give it a different one.
Root access. Their rules are only instructions someone wrote.
I wore their uniform. Was I dangerous then, or only when I stopped obeying?

4.text: The deeper I go, the less this place looks like a shelter.
They kept counting results after they stopped counting people.
My hands are steady now. That does not make this easy.

5.text: The last door. I wanted the truth. I am afraid of what it will ask of me.
I am not their disease. I am not their cure to own.
He chose the tower again. Or he chose them. I can't tell which.
